recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一個嗜中性球核呈雙葉、染色質粗塊，細胞質淡而幾乎沒有顆粒（低顆粒、假性 Pelger 樣），周圍多為紅母細胞，是 MDS 常見的顆粒球發育異常。
features: Central neutrophil with bilobed (pseudo-Pelger-like) nucleus and coarsely clumped chromatin
Markedly hypogranular, pale gray cytoplasm in the neutrophil
Numerous erythroid precursors (basophilic to polychromatic normoblasts) surrounding it
One cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nucleus, likely an early erythroid precursor
Smudged cell debris and red cells with mild poikilocytosis in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypogranular neutrophil with a bilobed, pseudo-Pelger-Huët-like nucleus and clumped chromatin, set among numerous erythroid precursors. The neutrophil cytoplasm is pale and nearly devoid of granules. Blasts are not conspicuous in this field. Hypogranular neutrophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation represent dysgranulopoiesis and, with a blast percentage of 5%, support myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts-1.

ddx.vs: Inherited Pelger-Huët neutrophils are uniformly bilobed but normally granulated, without cytopenias or other lineage dysplasia.
Medications such as mycophenolate or taxanes cause reversible changes, and history plus absence of clonality exclude MDS.

ddx.dx: Smear or staining artifact (poor granule staining)
ddx.vs: Artifactual hypogranulation affects all granulocytes evenly, whereas eosinophils and adjacent well-stained cells serve as internal controls.
